1987.title: Gran Eventos is Born
1987.description: Gran Eventos was founded with a passion for creating unforgettable experiences through event production.
1987.fullDesc: In 1987, two visionaries laid the foundation for what would become the technical and logistical benchmark for major events in the country. Equipped with a single trailer and hand-drawn blueprints, the company began its journey driven by a passion for flawless execution and operational excellence.
highlights: First GE mobile assistance truck
Artisanal design of temporary power grids
Servicing the first local festivals

1995.title: First Major Concerts
1995.description: We expanded our technical capacity and supported the country's first major concerts.
1995.fullDesc: During the 1990s, the entertainment industry took off in the region. Gran Eventos drastically expanded its truss infrastructure and electrical distribution systems, supporting national tours for iconic international artists.
highlights: Acquisition of heavy-duty truss structures
Specialization in massive sound reinforcement and support
First large-scale stadium contracts

2000.title: Energy Specialization
2000.description: We specialized in power generation for massive events, ensuring reliability and safety.
2000.fullDesc: With the turn of the millennium, strategic focus turned toward critical energy reliability. Next-generation soundproof generators and N+1 redundant systems were deployed to prevent disruptions during live shows.
highlights: Implementation of automatic power transfer switches
Certified technical personnel in temporary high voltage
Creation of the GE Zero Interruption protocol

2005.title: National Expansion
2005.description: We brought our expertise to more cities across Colombia, consolidating our position as a strategic entertainment partner.
2005.fullDesc: Gran Eventos expanded operations across the entire Colombian territory, from the Caribbean Coast to the Southwest. The company became the key technical partner for touring festivals and major corporate events.
highlights: Presence at Colombia's major festivals
Proprietary transport logistics for complex locations
Partnerships with the country's largest promoters

2010.title: Industry Leaders
2010.description: We participate in the country's most prominent events, collaborating with world-class artists, brands, and producers.
2010.fullDesc: By 2010, the GE brand was synonymous with absolute guarantee. World-renowned pop and rock tours demanded Gran Eventos' infrastructure for their stops in the country, establishing international technical standards.
highlights: End-to-end supply for full stadium setups
Compliance with demanding international technical riders
Fleet modernization of GE soundproof modules

2015.title: Technological Efficiency
2015.description: We adopted new technologies and efficient solutions to optimize energy consumption at events.
2015.fullDesc: We initiated a deep technological re-engineering focused on smart consumption. Integrating real-time telemetry and remote load monitoring, we significantly reduced diesel consumption per generated kilowatt.
highlights: Dynamic load management systems
Noise footprint reduction in urban environments
ISO 45001 occupational health and safety certifications

2020.title: Adaptation and the Future
2020.description: We adapted to new formats and challenges, strengthening our infrastructure and talent to keep connecting people.
2020.fullDesc: In the face of unprecedented global challenges in 2020, Gran Eventos diversified its capabilities toward rapid response centers, high-power streaming broadcasts, and temporary infrastructure for strategic sectors.
highlights: Technical and logistical response in record time
Development of hybrid command centers
Planning for sustainable energy transition

2023.title: SETIE Strategic Alliance
2023.description: Together with SETIE, we began a new chapter toward renewable energy, integrating sustainable solutions.
2023.fullDesc: The union with SETIE (Soluciones Energéticas Temporales) was formed. This revolutionary alliance introduced large-scale battery storage, mobile photovoltaic solar microgrids, and hybrid generators to the entertainment industry.
highlights: Official launch of the joint SETIE brand
First major concert powered by stored solar energy
Circular economy integration in event production

2026.title: Same Passion Greener Tomorrow
2026.description: We continue to innovate for more sustainable events, connecting technology, people, and the planet.
2026.fullDesc: In 2026, we consolidated our role as absolute pioneers in 100% net-zero events across the region. Combining the same technical passion with wind, solar, and green hydrogen technology, we power large stages without leaving a trace.
highlights: High-performance portable wind and solar systems
Green Certification for international productions
The same passion from 1987 with tomorrow's cleanest technology
